flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of taking Senate control slipped slightly, though they remain the favoured party. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts had a sharp rise in the market's confidence, while in [[Kansas]], the Democrat Adam Hamilton lost a moderate amount of ground in a race the market predicts will flip. In [[Ohio]], the Democrat Sherrod Brown gained moderately, and the market also lists that seat as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground by a sizable margin, and the market treats it as a predicted flip. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Jim Pillen also strengthened noticeably. Over in [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds saw a sizable drop in Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats favoured to win control of the House, and their chances edged up slightly. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp drop in chances, while in [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]] the Republican Dan Green slipped by a sizable margin in what the market calls a predicted flip. The Democrat Jamie Ager also lost ground, by a moderate amount, in [[NC-11 (Asheville & Hendersonville)]], another predicted flip.
